stem.text: A ball of mass $0.20\,\text{kg}$, travelling in the $x$-direction at a speed of $0.50\,\text{m s}^{-1}$, collides with a ball of mass $0.30\,\text{kg}$ travelling in the $y$-direction at a speed of $0.40\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
The two balls stick together after the collision, travelling at an angle $\theta$ to the $x$-direction.

stem.alt: Two balls: a 0.20 kg ball moving right with speed 0.50 m s-1 along the x-direction, and a 0.30 kg ball moving down with speed 0.40 m s-1 along the y-direction. An arrow drawn at angle theta to the x-direction after the collision.
